title: Spigots and hose bibs.
officialText: Spigots and hose bibs dispensing recycled water shall be secured from unauthorized use by a locking mechanism. Signage reading “Caution: Non-potable water, do not drink” shall be placed adjacent to the location of spigots and hose bibs.
